The operator-facing surfaces of this story are the pipeline run view, the release view, the dashboards and the runbook. edits.old: - No build dependency: this story is Day 1 by rule (Template and Rules §R5.7).
edits.new:
- No build dependency: this story is Day 1 by rule (Template and Rules §R5.7).
- The agent platform of DL33 is rwb-agent (P10, wave 1). Its task queue `rwb-agent` is the only place a model call is made; no other service and no workflow code calls the model endpoint (GAP-0080).
- The two read-only tools of rwb-agent are case facts and score, read through the data-product contract of rwb-source-data (P1), and extracted document fields, read through the REST contract of rwb-document (P5) (GAP-0083).
- The fallback-rate measure is not defined in this story. Until its definition, target and window are approved as rwb-reporting rows and its parameters as rwb-case parameter rows at the wave 1 measures review, this story asserts only that the fallback fact and the agent version are on the entry (GAP-1316).
- Open points of the intake shadow run (GAP-0610): the login of rwb-agent is agreed with the ACE database team and the route with the edge owner; legacy AC5 and TC-E1-059-05 are carried by RWB-ITG-E1059-ITG, not by this story; RWB-P5-E1053-CON is added to the contract dependencies of a later version when it is published; the sample and evaluation operations are assigned with the evaluation story of the epic.
- The login of rwb-agent is referenced through a platform secret. The five alert rules and six runbook entries are drafted for sign-off by the on-call rota, and the route path is published from the edge contract when it is baselined (GAP-2189).
- The consumer group, the Flyway user and the property names of the service, and the time, timezone and overlap policy of the nightly chain check, are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2420). The chain-check time is taken from the decision-log store slice that owns JOB-14.
- The model version of agent INTAKE is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2421). The model version on the entry is asserted equal to the run fixture, not to a literal.
